HOW TO PLAY & WIN

🎯 Tetris Logic & How to Win

Kappo chip packets drop from the top. Position and rotate pieces to complete solid horizontal lines across the 10-column grid without gaps!

  • ✨ Full Batch Clear (Mono-Flavor): Fill a row where every block is the same flavor to trigger a signature color flash, Kappo logo stamp, packet confetti burst & 3x score multiplier! Stack multiple mono-flavor rows for Double or Triple Batch bonuses!
  • Line Clear (Crunch Combo): Filled rows clear normally with base points. Mixed flavor rows are never penalized!
  • ⚡ FULL CRUNCH (4-Line Clear): Clear 4 lines at once with the straight Cassava Dynamite piece for massive jackpot score!
  • Batch Levels: Speed increases every 10 cleared lines. Win by setting your personal Best Stack high score!

📱 Direct Screen Touch Controls (Mobile)

Tap Left / Right Screen: Move Left / Right
Drag Finger Left / Right: Smooth Column Slide
Tap Center / Top Screen: Rotate Piece (↻)
Fast Swipe Down: ⚡ Hard Drop
Swipe Up / Tap Hold Box: Hold Piece (📦)

🌶️ 4 Kappo Flavor Skins

Cassava Dynamite (Spicy Red 🔥)
Tangy Tomato (Tomato Red 🍅)
Banana Chili Garlic (Green 🧄)
Banana Classic Salted (Golden Yellow 🍌)
